Name: Nyapu Shadow (After Dark Series)
Author: spiriituals
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b]
[/size]I edited and color altered some portraits provided by Nyapu and Aelinore-- none of this is my art, only some small edits to give the appearance of the NPC included in the "Shadows After Dark" mod by loshionbottle!

A/N Honestly, it's such a miniscule detail considering the size of the mod, but I'm a bit of a perfectionist who must have ALL nyapu portraits in their game :P

^^Apologies if there's any misalignment as I did not test the portraits in my own game. Please let me now if you notice any pesky pixels where they should not be!

Credits to Nyapu and Aelinore for the assets! Credits to loshionbottle for the NPC mod!

[size=4][b]Installation instructions:[/b]
[/size]Unzip the download file "ShadowsNPC" and then drag the "[CP] Shadows After Dark" folder into your already existing mods folder where you keep the main mod. When you are prompted to replace files of the same name-- do so.
OR you can find the "portraits" folder at --[i][CP] Shadows After Dark\Data\Shadow[/i]-- yourself and drag the replacers into it. Personally, I tend to do this just to ensure everything goes neatly where it is supposed to :P

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b]
[/size]These are REPLACERS! You need the "Shadows After Dark" mod for these to work.

Downloads.Description: Replacers!! Drag and click the unzipped folder into your mods folder!
